changes.zh: 对话侧栏按任务列出：待你处理的单独成组，最近的在前，可打开全部任务表搜索和筛选。
changes.en: The conversation rail lists tasks: those waiting for you are grouped first, recent ones follow, and a full task table can be searched and filtered.

changes.zh: 项目成果里，被当前计划取代、没跑到分析的早期尝试会收起，不再一条条标红。
changes.en: In project results, early attempts superseded by the current plan that never reached an analysis are folded instead of listed in red.

changes.zh: 研究可以使用无呼吸机天数等“存活且无事件天数”、有序结局和计数结局。
changes.en: Studies can use free-day outcomes such as ventilator-free days, ordinal outcomes and count outcomes.

changes.zh: 新增跨库外部验证、各数据库效应的 REML 合并、g-方法（MSM 与单时点 g-formula）和重复测量的混合模型与 GEE。
changes.en: Adds cross-database external validation, REML pooling of per-database effects, g-methods (MSM and point g-formula) and mixed models and GEE for repeated measures.

changes.zh: 支持多重插补并按 Rubin 规则合并；数据预处理（异常值、时间窗汇总、单位统一、缺失处理、标准化）在计划中逐项可见。
changes.en: Supports multiple imputation pooled by Rubin's rules; data preparation (outliers, window aggregation, units, missing data, scaling) is listed step by step in the plan.

changes.zh: 在输入框输入 / 可以直接选用技能。
changes.en: Typing / in the composer picks a skill directly.

changes.zh: 设置中可选择数据和项目的存放位置；桌面版用系统钥匙串记住模型密钥。
changes.en: Settings choose where data and projects are stored; the desktop app remembers model keys in the system keychain.

changes.zh: 技能中心各页统一标题与操作；技能可以打包导入导出。
changes.en: Skill Hub tabs share one header and actions; skills can be imported and exported as packages.

changes.zh: 新增 MIMIC-III 官方演示数据，可以在旧版 MIMIC 结构上从抽取一直做到出图。
changes.en: Adds the official MIMIC-III demo, so the whole path from extraction to figures also runs on the older MIMIC structure.

changes.zh: 在对话侧栏点搜索，可以查找所有项目里的对话、计划、结果和文件，点开直接到对应的位置。
changes.en: Search from the conversation rail finds conversations, plans, results and files in every project and opens the exact place.

changes.zh: 需要你确认的计划、已完成或失败的运行会在项目和对话旁标出，浏览器标签上显示待处理的数量。
changes.en: Plans waiting for you and runs that finished or failed are marked beside their project and conversation, with the count in the browser tab.

changes.zh: 科学审阅逐项列出方法、数据与材料、数字核对和局限，每一项都能查看来源；没有证据记录的数字排在最前并标出。
changes.en: Scientific review lists the approach, data and materials, number check and limitations item by item, each with its source; numbers without an evidence record come first and are marked.

changes.zh: 结果下方会给出可以直接追加的后续分析。
changes.en: Results suggest follow-up analyses you can add directly.

changes.zh: 在输入框里选研究技能，或设为项目新对话的默认技能；内置技能可以复制成自己的版本再修改。
changes.en: Pick a research skill in the composer or make it the project's default for new conversations; copy a built-in skill to edit your own version.

changes.zh: 设置里可以写给 Copilot 的长期说明；模型菜单里显示本对话和最近一次分析的用量。
changes.en: Settings take standing instructions for Copilot; the model menu shows usage for this conversation and the latest analysis.

changes.zh: 可以下载一项研究的回放，发给导师或合作者：问题、计划、结果和汇总图表，只含汇总数据；有少于 20 人的分组时不会生成。
changes.en: Download a study's replay to send to a supervisor or co-author: question, plan, results and aggregate figures only; it is not made when a group has fewer than 20 patients.

changes.zh: 每次运行和每段对话都能查看发送给模型的记录：用途、服务商、内容类型和大小，不显示发出的原文。
changes.en: Every run and conversation shows what was sent to the model: purpose, provider, kind of content and size, never the text sent.

changes.zh: 运行出问题时可以下载问题报告：只含版本、运行状态和原因代码，不含数据、提示词和对话内容，由你决定是否发给支持人员。
changes.en: When a run goes wrong you can download a problem report with versions, run state and reason codes only, no data, prompts or conversation text, and decide yourself whether to send it.
